- [2025-03-17] standup/atlas/2025-03-17: If the auth gateway is down, the ledger service is down: it relies on it for service tokens.

- [2025-09-09] standup/boreal/2025-09-09: Changes to the billing API need a rollback plan attached to the pull request.
- [2026-05-26] handover/2026-05-26-billing-api: Ownership change: billing-api now sits with the Dune team. Boreal no longer owns it.

- [2025-09-08] standup/boreal/2025-09-08-2: New dependency for billing-api: feature-flags. Billing-api will gate the new invoice flow behind feature-flags; the reasoning is that the rollout needs a per-tenant kill switch. Boreal noticed that the notifier's request volume halved after the client rollout and pinged the owners.

- [2025-04-28] incident-review/INC-2025-011: INC-2025-011 review. What happened: the ledger service saw write latency spike tenfold for an hour on 2025-04-26. Why: an index missing after the schema migration. Follow-up decision: ledger migrations will ship with a reviewed query plan, because a missing index after a migration caused INC-2025-011.
- [2025-03-17] handover/2025-03-17-billing-api: Atlas handed billing-api to team Boreal today; Tomasz wrote up the handover doc for Marcus.
- [2025-03-28] handover/2025-03-28-webhooks: From today the pager for the webhooks service rings the Atlas team, not team Boreal. Ownership transferred.
- [2025-10-22] standup/dune/2025-10-22: We agreed today that webhooks will sign payloads with rotating keys. The reason is that a partner asked for key rotation in their security review.
- [2025-04-18] standup/atlas/2025-04-18: Per the change policy, Ledger deploys on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC.

- [2025-02-21] standup/cinder/2025-02-21: Rotation day for team Cinder: Yuki Tanaka hands the pager to Diego Alvarez. Team Cinder saw that the auth gateway's cold start time tripled following the runtime upgrade; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2025-04-03] handover/2025-04-03-event-bus: Ownership change: the event bus now sits with the Atlas team. The Boreal team no longer owns it.
- [2025-11-13] handover/2025-11-13-ledger: The ledger has a new home: team Ember. Team Atlas kept it until today.
- [2026-01-13] standup/atlas/2026-01-13: The Atlas team noticed that Ledger's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change and pinged the owners.
- [2025-11-20] handover/2025-11-20-event-bus: Boreal is taking over the bus from team Cinder, effective today. Dashboards and alerts are being repointed.

- [2026-01-22] incident-review/INC-2026-003: Incident review INC-2026-003. Webhooks delivered some events twice on 2026-01-17. Root cause: a retry loop that ignored idempotency keys. Decision: webhooks will require an idempotency key on every delivery, because duplicate deliveries in INC-2026-003 came from retries without one.
